grid_extension_input_invalid.why: get_grid_extension_break_even was given an input that is not finite or out of range (negative eur_per_km, non-positive max_km, a malformed grid_basis). Nothing ran; the assistant corrects the number the message names.

basis_mismatch.why: get_grid_extension_break_even: grid_basis differs from the study's discount rate, horizon, currency or currency year. Nothing is converted; the assistant restates the grid cost on the expected basis (named in the result) or tells the user it cannot.

assumptions_not_set.why: get_grid_extension_break_even: the study has no stored ledger, discount rate, horizon or currency year. The assistant asks the user to set them in the study; it never invents a default.

discount_rate_invalid.why: get_grid_extension_break_even: the study's discount rate is not finite or is at or below -100%. The assistant asks the user to correct it in the study.

npc_not_finite.why: get_grid_extension_break_even: the annuity factor or derived off-grid NPC is not a finite number. The assistant reports that no break-even was computed.

supply_architectures_running.why: get_grid_extension_break_even: the supply-architecture comparison is still running. The assistant waits and polls get_supply_architectures.

supply_architectures_stale.why: get_grid_extension_break_even: the base project changed since the comparison, so its rows are not current. The assistant offers to compare the architectures again; it never presents the old figure as current.

supply_architectures_not_evaluated.why: get_grid_extension_break_even: the stored comparison cannot be read or is of an unknown version. The assistant offers to compare again.

architecture_unknown.why: get_grid_extension_break_even: architecture_id is not in the stored table. The assistant reads the ids from get_supply_architectures.

architecture_not_solved.why: get_grid_extension_break_even: that architecture is infeasible, failed, not reached or has no annual cost, so it has no off-grid NPC. The assistant says so and offers another architecture.
